attributes.action: To have the Gap x JYT collab available for people in the UK to buy.
attributes.additional_details: This would be benefitial for the UK JYT fans as the fanbase isn't just from the US and the UK should definitely be included into this as Toby (one of the members of JYT) is from the UK himself, so this would most definitely be benefitial as this includes him and the fanbase which are also from the UK who would really want to buy the sets but are unfortunately unable to as only the US can buy the sets which is definitely unfair to the UK JYT fans.
attributes.background: This petition is to have the Gap x JYT collab sweat sets available for people in the UK to buy, as they are only available in the US and cannot be purcharsed in the UK and JYT's fanbase aren't just people from the US but are also from all over the world, including the UK.
